label: prop:collatz-no-cycles
title: Balanced-holonomy cycle exclusion: coprimality of $[2]_q$ and $[3]_q$
html:
Proposition (balanced-holonomy cycle exclusion, within a QOU). Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe with substrate parameter q and Skein module \mathcal{S}(q) \cong \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}]. The Skein-Collatz map \mathcal{C}_q has no periodic orbit of balanced multiplicative holonomy — none with A = \prod_i a_i = 1 — other than the degenerate fixed point. Equivalently, [3]_q^{k_{\mathrm{odd}}} = [2]_q^{k} has no solution with k_{\mathrm{odd}} \geq 1, by coprimality of [2]_q and [3]_q.

Full nontrivial-cycle exclusion — the affine (A \neq 1) case — is part of the open q-Collatz conjecture, not of this proposition; see the proof and contact boundary.
